sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:150324
Court No. - 71

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 52293 of 2023
Applicant :- Jitendra Pal Singh

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Kamla Singh,Sarvajeet Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
1.
Heard Sri Kamla Singh,learned counsel for the applicant and Sri S.K.Ojha, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that vide order dated 23.01.2024 the applicant was granted interim bail by this Court subject to condition that he will deposit remaining amount of Rs.7.86 lacs in two installments.

3. Para 11 of the order dated 23.01.2024 reads as under:-
"11.

In the event, the applicant deposits the remaining amount of Rs.7.86 lacs before the court concerned in two installments after releasing, i.e. out of 7.86 lacs, 50% shall be paid on or before 23.04.2024 and rest 50% shall be deposited on or before 23.07.2024, the applicant would not be required to surrender before the court concerned.

However, in case of default in deposit of the remaining amount before the court concerned as directed, the applicant shall surrender before the court concerned Jitendra Pal Singh vs State Of U.P. on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197442054/
1 on or before 22.04.2024 and file an affidavit in this respect before this Court."
4. After releasing the applicant moved an application for extension of time which was allowed vide order dated 03.05.2024.

sentences.text: It was observed that the time extension application shall be heard after an affidavit is moved before this Court regarding the fact that the applicant has surrendered before the court concerned.
The applicant has surrendered before the trial court concerned on 10.05.2024.
The information is brought on record by filing supplementary affidavit.
5. It is also submitted that the applicant has deposited entire amount of Rs.7,86,000/-.
This information is brought on record by filing supplementary affidavit filed on 10.9.2024.

6. Considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and fact that the applicant has deposited entire amount of Rs.7,86,000/- without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

7. Let applicant Jitendra Pal Singh, involved in Case Crime No.65 of 2023, under sections 420, 406,
467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station, Fatehganj East, District Bareilly be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned,
subject to the following conditions:
(1). The applicant will not tamper with the prosecution evidence during the trial.
(2). The applicant will not influence any witness.
(3).
The applicant will appear before the trial Court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

(4). The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
8. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move an application before this Court seeking cancellation of the bail.

Order Date :- 13.9.2024 Asha  Jitendra Pal Singh vs State Of U.P. on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197442054/
